150 THE SAVOY MALE AND FEMALE COLLEGE

fessional men joined in sending the letter of appreciation quoted in the following newspaper clipping:

SEND CONGRATULATIONS
Prof. R. R. Halsell Remembered by His Old Pupils

The following communication was sent to Prof. R. R. Halsell, who has been elected a member of the Oklahoma legislature. Prof. Halsell many years ago conducted the Savoy College and is remembered by many former students.

Dear Prof. Halsell: We, the undersigned, extend to you our heartfelt congratulations on your election to the legislature of Oklahoma. It would be impossible for us to express how dear and precious to our hearts are the memories of those pleasant days spent under your guidance and instruction at the Savoy College. I have further to congratulate you as a man, for your devotion to your home, your State, and your fellow men.

Oklahoma is certainly fortunate to have the services of your scholarship, and we trust that your government can bring to her counties.

Well do we appreciate those years of self-sacrifice and devotion, with which you inspired and aided us when we were struggling against almost insurmountable odds. Our state was new, her progress had been stopped by the devastation of the war, and was but poorly equipped, and those of you who devoted your lives to building institutions of learning were few and poorly equipped, and the fields from which to derive support were limited. Yet such men as you and your co-laborers among us were deeper, the less higher, and the fields larger than they are now. Without the foundation built by you and those working with you in establishing and maintaining our higher institutions of learning, proper education would have been practically impossible.

We wish you all the joys, comforts, and blessings that life can give you in the remaining days that shall remain, and trust that you have not forgotten them.

I am, with the sincerest of all wishes for your future,
Ed. A. McMaron.
